// @camis:generated — do not edit; regenerated by camis
import { Router } from "express";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "../db/client";
import { entries } from "../db/schema";
import { tooLong } from "../lengths";

function pick(obj: Record<string, unknown>, keys: string[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const k of keys) if (k in obj) out[k] = obj[k];
  return out;
}

/** Each bounded field's maxLength, in characters. */
const MAX_LENGTHS: Record<string, number> = { code: 40, body: 1000, notes: 2000, contact: 320, slug: 300 };

export const entriesRouter = Router();

entriesRouter.get("/", (_req, res) => {
  res.json(db.select().from(entries).all());
});

entriesRouter.get("/:id", (req, res) => {
  const row = db.select().from(entries).where(eq(entries.id, Number(req.params.id))).get();
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.json(row);
});

entriesRouter.post("/", (req, res) => {
  const longer = tooLong(req.body, MAX_LENGTHS);
  if (longer !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: longer });
    return;
  }
  const data = pick(req.body, ["title", "code", "body", "notes", "contact", "slug"]);
  const row = db.insert(entries).values(data).returning().get();
  res.status(201).json(row);
});

entriesRouter.patch("/:id", (req, res) => {
  const longer = tooLong(req.body, MAX_LENGTHS);
  if (longer !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: longer });
    return;
  }
  const data = pick(req.body, ["title", "code", "body", "notes", "contact", "slug"]);
  const row = db.update(entries).set(data).where(eq(entries.id, Number(req.params.id))).returning().get();
  if (!row) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.json(row);
});

entriesRouter.delete("/:id", (req, res) => {
  db.delete(entries).where(eq(entries.id, Number(req.params.id))).run();
  res.status(204).end();
});
